games.name: Secret Universe
games.desc:
[PARTS OF THIS GAME ARE VERY HARD TO SOLVE, TRY USING TUTORIALS IF YOU GET STUCK!]

Like a tycoon game, except the most valuable currency is knowledge.

[❓] It's an empty baseplate... Or is it?
[🔎] Each secret you discover will add a brand new structure to your world.
[💸] Every structure you find gives you money ($U) based on difficulty, and some introduce new ways of gaining it.
[🏆] How rich can you get? Can you find all 141 secrets?

Good luck! The universe is rooting for you...

[NOTE]: All music that plays in the game is completely royalty-free.

Game by @Feodoric
Inspired by Neal.fun's "Stimulation Clicker" (& more)

games.name: Build Your Factory Tycoon [ALPHA]
games.desc:
🏭 Welcome to Build Your Factory Tycoon! 🔧

🏗️ In BYFT you claim your own plot, build a powerful factory using machines and conveyors, and turn raw materials into profit! 💰

👍 Enjoying the game? Consider giving it a thumbs up - your support helps us grow. Thank you! 🙌

⚠️ The game is still under active development — everything is subject to change. Expect bugs and frequent updates! You’ll receive an Alpha Tester badge just for playing. 🏅

• Try out different machines to discover what items they produce. 🔍
• Upgrade machines to maximize efficiency. ⏫

games.name: Case Unboxing
games.desc:
💲 Strategy is Key!
Earn Cash and Unbox the Rarest Skins but spend wisely, figuring out the Best Strategy to gain more Cash is the skill needed. Reach New Zones which give Luck, use the Bank to Earn Money Overtime and climb the Leaderboard to become the Top Player! 🏆

✈️🪂 Airdrops! 
Airdrops are scheduled for the two-zero and four-zero minute marks of every hour. 
eg. 12:20 PM, 12:40 PM 
Eyes up and maintain situational awareness. 
Ensure you are clear of the drop zone or you will be compromised by the impact.

💎 Join our Community for an Extra +5% Luck Boost!

🔗 Have a suggestion? Join our community server!
🐞 Bugs? Try rejoining! If it's still there, report it in our community server!

games.name: Forgotten Stories (WIP)
games.desc:
Thumbnail art by @ayaadayo_

For console users, the game is only playable with Mouse and Keyboard, Apologies.

Game is still in very early development and some core features are yet to add!, you might get a few bugs and may look unbalanced for the meanwhile but ill try my best so everyone can enjoy it as i updated it!, as we as a community :D.

Hardcore turn-based game where you have to explore a tile based map with your party defeating monsters, Enhancing yourself with cool gear and writting books. Make a story that none will forget.

-Dodges-
A - Left
S - Down
D - Right
Space - Jump
F - Block / Parry 

Pay attention to the Qtes.
